I really wanted to like this, because I had absolutely LOVED it when I got it on a free weekend. But Ive played a few more games and noticed a few things. The characters faces are completely lifeless! Which would be fine, but in a game like this, the characters are a pretty big part. And on a related note, the voicelines just sound dead and completely emotionless. Theres also quite a bit of voiceline spam? Which shouldnt be happening especially when most of the quips are automatic, and outside of the players control. Playing the game itself seems weird, cause I cant specifically host a mission, so to play one from start to finish it seems like you have to either get extremely lucky, queue beforehand, or do a private match with AI, which just isnt as fun. The new guns dont feel good, although I'm pretty sure they've said thatll be fixed soon. But overall, gun recoil animations look kindof floaty and not great, and the lighting is abhorrent in almost all of at least Episode 1. It looks grainy and dusty and like theres a film over the whole screen. The gameplay is still fine, but ranged combat is entirely unbalanced and broken. You could play this game entirely with your pistol, and no perks- at least on normal difficulty, because the pistol and the AR feel exactly the same. One shot headshots from range and very few body shots to kill. Dont get me wrong, I absolutely love the pistol being able to one shot headshot, but it needs to be balanced some other way, like having limited range, and definitely less magazine capacity. Depending on your playstyle I suppose you might want to use the shotgun (although it just isnt as good as the others) or the SMG, (which is at least good if you just dont actually want to look at your screen, and just want to fire randomly into a crowd, and also has aim assist on PC for some reason??), but there really isnt a reason to. The pistol, especially with the burst fire upgrade, is the only weapon youll ever need. "You should just turn the difficulty up" I see your point, but normal difficulty is just straight up easy. I was only downed twice and it was because I wasnt paying attention because this game is just boring. The progression system is also kindof meaningless?? Just because there are some upgrades that are just kindof objectively the best, like the shield and upgraded pulse and the burst for the pistol. There also isnt any melee, not even a pistol whip, which kindof sucks because the basic zombies are obscenely fast. Some of this is probably just my opinion, but I genuinely loved it when I got it on that free weekend, and I'm a little sad I don't anymore. I know this is a lot to expect of an indie studio in early access, but its been at least a year since I first got it, and it doesn't seem to have actually improved. Go play Deep Rock Galactic, its fun, its got meaningful progression, and its a co-op wave shooter in a scifi setting. This game just doesn't add enough to the genre to make it fun, or really do what it does well enough in my opinion.

Seriously stylish game that nails a 70s future look. The general construction of the game is solid, plenty of fun weapons and eye candy enviroments. Hoping the story gets a little more fleshed out and sounds reworked. Hoping the devs continue to work on this game---but it does appear that there is regular updates. Lots of room to improve, but I'm ready to see what might come to this L4D2-style shooter. Great way to kill some time with friends!
Awesome game, dev team is friendly and it has some great potential! Looking forward to what is still to come!
Played a few games of this when it first launched in early access. I liked the interior maps a lot, they gave lots of room to explore while fending off wavering amounts of enemies
Very OK game. Left 4 dead is very similar, years older and is superior. Nice try though!

A really great co-op game with a distinctive flavor that manages to carry on the tradition of games like Left 4 Dead. Updates are thoughtful and substantial, and the developers are active and engaging with the great community they're building up around the game. One of my favorite aspects is the workshop integration, opening the door to all sorts of user generated content. Absolutely worth the buy!
